name: header-floating
title: Floating header
author: Lambda Curry <https://github.com/lambda-curry>
description: A detached, rounded navigation bar that floats below the top edge with a translucent surface and a native popover menu on narrow screens.

meta.useWhen: The site has four to six destinations plus one primary action, and the page below has imagery or color the bar can float over.
meta.avoidWhen: The site is a quiet single page, or the brand needs a large masthead. Use header-minimal or header-editorial instead.

docs: Import from src/components/blocks/HeaderFloating.astro. The narrow-screen menu uses the HTML popover attribute and needs no JavaScript.
